name: Penguin
intro: A penguin is a bird that cannot fly. It is a great swimmer.

sections.title: What does it look like?
sentences: A penguin is a bird with feathers.
It has a dark back and a white front.
Its wings are flat flippers.
Thick feathers keep it warm in cold water.
An emperor penguin is about as tall as a first grader.

sections.title: Where does it live?
sentences: Most penguins live in the south part of the world.
Some penguins live on the ice in Antarctica.
Some penguins live on warm beaches in Africa.
No penguins live near the North Pole.
Penguins spend lots of time in the ocean.

sections.title: What does it eat?
sentences: Penguins eat fish, squid, and krill.
They catch their food in the ocean.
They swallow their food whole.
Their spiky tongues help hold slippery fish.

sections.title: How does it grow?
sentences: Penguins hatch from eggs.
Most penguins lay two eggs.
An emperor penguin dad keeps the egg warm on his feet.
Moms and dads bring food to the chicks.
Some chicks stay together in a big group.

sections.title: Fun facts
sentences: Penguins cannot fly in the air.
They seem to fly through the water.
Gentoo penguins are the fastest swimming birds.
Penguins can drink salty sea water.
African penguins can sound like donkeys.

vocab.meaning: A flat wing that helps an animal swim.
